🛡️ Service Level Agreement (SLA) & HA Architecture

Deployment TierTarget SLAMax DowntimeTopology
Regional High Availability (Multi-Zone)99.95%21m 55s / mo • 4h 23m / yrManaged multi-zone regional deployment
Zonal / Standard Deployment99.9%43m 50s / mo • 8h 46m / yrSingle-zone or standard regional resource
HA Qualification Prerequisites:
  • Enable multi-zone High Availability (HA) within the region and avoid single-zone resource pinning.
  • Pair with a secondary DR region if business continuity requires survival of a full regional outage.

💰 FinOps Pricing Model, Free Tier & CUDs

Billing Model: Usage-Metered API Calls / Tokens / Compute Node-Hours
Metered Units: per-1k units / 1M tokens / accelerator-hour
Free Tier: Eligible Monthly free usage units on select Vision, Speech, Translation & NLP APIs
Committed Use Discounts: Provisioned Throughput / Compute CUDs on dedicated nodes
Key Cost Watchouts:
  • Synchronous real-time vs batch inference volume
  • Media duration (audio minutes / video seconds / document pages)
  • Dedicated endpoint minimum replica count
